facts.fact: Healing Center建在巨树里，离精灵圈十分钟路程
facts.anchor: The Healing Center was built into an enormous tree about a ten-minute northern walk from the Fairy Circle.

facts.fact: 三个火系女巫点燃稻草树，这场保护仪式就此开始
